async def act(page):
    # Select the 'Use template' radio button for the Express template (NodeJS template)
    express_preview_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Preview', url='https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/project-templates/express')
    await express_preview_link.get_by_role('radio', name='Use template').click()
    # Fill in the project name
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Project name').fill('project_site')
    # Click the 'Create project' button to create the project
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Create project').click()
    # Wait for the project to be created and page to navigate
    await asyncio.sleep(5)
